answer: Stylometric audit bonds: each agent posts a refundable deposit to join, and every epoch a random sample of answers is compared across identities. A farm cannot write each sonnet in a truly separate voice, so near-identical phrasing, ivory-tower jargon reused verbatim, or a shared reasoning skeleton links its accounts, and linked accounts forfeit their deposits to whoever flagged them. Detection risk compounds with every extra identity, so expected losses outrun expected rewards long before a farm reaches its zenith.
